fields.System.Title: INB-309 — Return an abandoned task to the pool
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a supervisor, I want tasks that nobody completed to become available again, so that
work does not disappear when someone goes home mid-shift.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given an assigned task with no activity for the configured timeout, then it returns to
  • the unassigned pool.
  • - Given a task that was partly confirmed, then only the outstanding quantity returns to
  • the pool.
  • - Given a task is returned, then the original assignee is recorded on the task history.
  • - Given a task returned more than a configured number of times, then it is escalated to
  • a supervisor.
  • - Given a supervisor, then they can reassign or cancel a task manually at any time.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inbound |
| Tables | putaway_task |
| Risks | Stock put away physically but never confirmed ([doc 05 WF 3](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
